cards.title: Meet Riff+
cards.body: Automix and its on-device beat analysis now live in Riff+, alongside Stats for nerds. Both editions are free.

cards.title: Your app equalizer
cards.body: The tone pad, seven manual bands, presets and balance are part of Riff+. Your saved settings stay with you when changing editions.

cards.title: All of Encore
cards.body: Listening statistics, stories, genres and the Encore widget are available in both Riff and Riff+.
